liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Ridiculously jazzy jam lasts over twenty minutes, closing the first set [17]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer praises the 1974 performance of this specific song [12]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Closing jam sequence includes He's Gone, U.S. Blues, WRS, and Eyes [16]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Phil's performance is considered the best version the reviewer has heard [13]
- **Spanish Jam** (1 review): Transition to Eyes is a standout, alongside a half-hour Playin' jam [12]

## The recordings

- **gd74-07-19.sbd.symons.12381.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 26 songs; 207 min; rated 4.56/5 by 57 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording features fresh original jams and full Weather Report Suite performance; Analog warmth rivals other era seeds with high quality sound [9][10]
- **gd1974-07-19.sbd.miller.32634.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 206 min; rated 4.49/5 by 35 [2]
- **gd1974-07-19.sbd.pre-dankfix.4596.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 201 min; rated 4.43/5 by 7 [3]
- **gd1974-07-19.shure.unknown.fix-102766.102866.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 191 min; rated 4.44/5 by 9 [5]

## Around the show

- Second set is the highlight, rivaling the May 14, 1974 show [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-07-19.sbd.symons.12381.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Source 12381 has 20-24db noise reduction, contrary to Tim Symons' claims; Mastering by Dave Greenberg, SHN conversion by Jay Gerland, organized by Jim Powell [1][15]
- **gd1974-07-19.sbd.miller.32634.sbeok.flac16**: taped by DAT from Rob Eaton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch Master Reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Cassette (Tascam 122mkIII) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/44.1k) [2]
- **gd1974-07-19.sbd.pre-dankfix.4596.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by DAT seed from Rob Eaton, DAT > SHN by Jamie Lutch; source: SBD>Master Reel>Cassette(1)>DAT@44.1K>DAT>WAV>Soundforge 4.0>CDWAV>SHN [3]
- **gd1974-07-19.shure.unknown.fix-102766.102866.flac16**: source: 2 Shure omni mics > Sony portable (152?) cassette recorder [5]. Also: Pitch corrected -72 cents from master playback for this Shure recording [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Fresno: [Grateful Dead Selland Arena Fresno CA 1974 Concert Poster](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/1595360/Grateful-Dead-Selland-Arena-Fresno-CA-1974-Concert-Poster) [21]
